dossier_meta.statement_text: Is there a deterministic adaptive algorithm that uses $o(\Delta^{3}\log(n/\Delta))$ queries to reconstruct any graph of maximum degree $\Delta$?
dossier_meta.context_text: For adaptive algorithms the best lower bound drops to $\Omega(\Delta^{2}\log(n/\Delta)/\log\Delta)$ in both the deterministic and randomised settings, while the upper bounds match the non-adaptive case. This gap suggests adaptive algorithms might outperform non-adaptive ones, motivating the question of whether adaptivity yields a provable saving.
